answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 46815 Country: India Title: Interest money Question: Can any person use his interest money for the construction of toilets for masjid and that like for Diniyat madrasa as well. So what is your fatwa? Answer ID: 46815 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1105/1110/M=9/1434) It is not right to use the interest money to construct toilets for the mosque or madrasa. Such malicious amount should be given in charity to the poor and needy ones without the intention of reward. لأن سبيل الكسب الخبيث التصدق الخ (شامى) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
